record.original_question: Suppose M is a complex manifold of dimension 2, and suppose ∀K compact ⊂ M there exists an open subset U, K ⊂ U ⊂ M such that U is biholomorphic to the unit ball. Does this imply that M is equivalent to the unit ball B, Delta × C or C^2 ? (This is false in C3 ).

evidence.quote: Problem 4.3.2 Suppose M is a complex manifold of dimension 2, and suppose ∀K compact ⊂ M there exists an open subset U, K ⊂ U ⊂ M such that U is biholomorphic to the unit ball. Does this imply that M is equivalent to the unit ball B, ∆ × C or C2 ? (This is false in C3 ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a connected complex manifold of complex dimension $2$. Assume that for every compact subset $K \subset M$ there exists an open subset $U$ with $K \subset U \subset M$ such that $U$ is biholomorphic to the open unit ball $B = \{z \in \mathbb{C}^2 : |z| < 1\}$. Does it follow that $M$ is biholomorphic to one of the following: the unit ball $B \subset \mathbb{C}^2$, the product $\Delta \times \mathbb{C}$ (where $\Delta$ is the open unit disk in $\mathbb{C}$), or $\mathbb{C}^2$?

(It is known that the analogous statement in dimension $3$ fails: there exist complex manifolds of dimension $3$ exhausted in the above sense by balls that are not biholomorphic to the ball, $\Delta \times \mathbb{C}^2$, $\Delta^2 \times \mathbb{C}$, or $\mathbb{C}^3$.)
artifact.status_search_result: The union problem in $\mathbb{C}^2$ for exhaustions by balls remains an active topic of research. Recent works (e.g., on exhaustion of hyperbolic complex manifolds and limits of increasing sequences of complex manifolds, 2021–2022) treat partial results under additional hypotheses such as Kobayashi hyperbolicity or restrictions on the exhausting domains, but a complete classification answering the dimension-2 ball case in full generality was not found.

status_evidence.title: Exhaustion of hyperbolic complex manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the union problem for hyperbolic complex manifolds exhausted by balls/Levi corank one domains, treating partial cases.
status_evidence.claim: The union problem is still being studied under additional hyperbolicity assumptions, indicating no general resolution in dimension 2.

status_evidence.title: Limits of an increasing sequence of complex manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Recent 2022 paper on increasing sequences of complex manifolds related to the union problem.
status_evidence.claim: Continued recent activity suggests the problem in full generality is not closed.
